summary: Native CLI service lookups accept Fractal daemon and replication names as well as existing names, and reject conflicting installations before service mutations.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

compatibility.detail: CLI status, restart, stop, reset and uninstall resolve st3/fractal systemd units and launchd labels, including instances. Linux also recognises Home Manager's smalltalk.service. Multiple present or loaded names are an error, not a preference. Installers continue writing existing names and refuse to install over a renamed service. Script and Home Manager cutover support remains separate.

downtime.detail: Lookup-only expansion: no service is renamed or restarted by upgrading the binary.

manual.detail: No host migration is performed or required by this change.

recovery.detail: Existing service definitions and drop-ins are unchanged.
